1. **Chart type**: Arrow/range chart showing change between two time points for each industry on a common horizontal scale.

2. **Layout techniques**:  
- Uses **small multiples / sectioned layout**: a main panel for “various industries” and a separate lower panel for “Technology companies since 2012.”  
- Each row is a separate category (industry).  
- No stacking or faceting by grid panels beyond the two sectioned groups.

3. **Data variables**:

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Industry | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (rows), text labels |
| Combined market share of the two largest companies (%) | Quantitative | Position on x-axis |
| Time point (Early 2000s / Now; 2012 / Now in technology section) | Temporal | Arrow start and end positions along x-axis, endpoint annotations |
| Direction of change (increase vs decrease) | Ordinal / derived | Arrow direction (rightward vs leftward), color (red vs gray) |
| Industry group/section (“various industries” vs “Technology companies since 2012”) | Categorical/nominal | Separate panel/section layout with section heading |
